entries.en: Test

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I think I'm gettin' kinda carsick...[n]Drivin' around on train tracks ain't[n]exactly the smoothest ride in the world.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That platform on the other side looks[n]real crowded. I wonder where they're[n]all goin'...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ahhh, nothing beats the feeling of[n]the earth under your feet! I get all[n]antsy when I ain't grounded.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, what're you doin' this weekend?[n]We should hang out!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're on a roll right now! Let's keep[n]changin' those hearts!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're really good at makin' those[n]lockpicks, ya know that? I wish I had[n]that kinda skill.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The weirdest shit happens here...[n]I swear, it makes those lame haunted[n]houses look like friggin' jokes.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't it gettin' spookier in here?[n]Should we, uh... Should we call it[n]a day for now?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know things are a mess up there[n]right now, but we can't just blow off[n]a person who needs help, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This place is so enormous... There just[n]HAS to be something at the end!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Now there's a surprise... I didn't expect[n]Mementos to just keep goin' like this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Gettin' the blood pumping's the best[n]way to warm up on a cold day like this!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I bet you're nice and comfy riding[n]around in me, right? You sure didn't[n]expect that, didja?
Yes, it's quite nice.
Actually, I'm carsick right now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heheh, knew it! Keep the[n]compliments coming!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well... Uh... Driving on the tracks is[n]going to be bumpy. Nothing I can do[n]about that!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's all thanks to Mishima that we can[n]change targets' hearts in Mementos.[n]Make sure to thank him for his help!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Could this... Could this finally be my[n]chance to sit beside Panther and...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've been finding some scratches on[n]my frame... Please drive carefully...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, I just wanna say, uh... Sorry about[n]before. I'm not going anywhere without[n]you anymore.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: With as many people as we have with[n]us now, we're sure to reach the bottom[n]of Mementos eventually!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I just realized I'm pretty full up![n]I might be a little slow-going, but[n]I'll get us where we need to be!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Changing the target's heart is great and[n]all, but we've gotta be as prepared as[n]we possibly can.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I told you I'd stick with you, Joker.[n]Make sure you don't disappear on me[n]either, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just a little further... Then I finally[n]learn the truth about myself...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh wow, I never thought I'd be carrying[n]around as many as nine people...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I can keep going! This is the time[n]to show you what I'm made of!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This place is so creepy. What's with[n]these, like, blood vessely things[n]all over the place?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: My nose has been bothering me...[n]Was the pollen really bad today or[n]something?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm so glad Makoto's with us now![n]I was sick of doing this with just a[n]bunch of guys...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I feel like we're being watched from[n]the other side of the platform...[n]It's giving me the heebie-jeebies.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah, have you been collecting[n]stamps? There always seems to be[n]one by the floor exit there.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves have been crazy[n]popular lately. It's a little scary, actually.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We can't lose sight of who we really are[n]ever again.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There are still a whole bunch of people[n]lined up on the other platform. It's[n]creepy how their train never comes...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It feels wrong not seeing you at school.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I just realized the year's almost over![n]We've been exploring Mementos for[n]a whole six months now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's gotten really cold out lately...[n]I think it's about time I bought[n]some warmer clothes.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's nice diving back into Mementos[n]after the first shrine visit of the year.[n]I really never get tired of this!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I never could've imagined seeing this in[n]Shibuya's underground... It seems I'm[n]always discovering new things with you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This lack of visibility is rather[n]unsettling... How immense[n]is this place?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hmm... A tail makes sitting in a chair[n]rather uncomfortable...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I suppose as the Phantom Thieves,[n]we should be grateful that people[n]are constantly providing us targets.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Such a wealth of inspiration...[n]Does anyone have a pencil and paper!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's grown quite cramped in here...[n]Very different from when I first joined[n]back in May.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My, I've grown quite hungry... Perhaps[n]I will bring a snack next time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: *chuckle* I'm pleased that I have the[n]opportunity to explore this place[n]again with you, Joker.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Our long exploration of Mementos[n]is finally reaching an end... Whatever[n]could we find there?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Could I ask for a bit more space in[n]the car? It's grown quite cramped...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's grown cold out... Nothing tops[n]hot pot for dinner on days like these.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The collective unconscious of the[n]masses—I understand the logic,[n]but... why a train station?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The weather's been rather fickle lately...[n]I wish we had more sunny days.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How's it going? Would you like me[n]to take over? I'm actually fairly[n]confident in my driving.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ummm, do you ever hear strange[n]voices when we're here? It— It's just[n]my imagination, right...?
It's your imagination.
Look, behind you!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ah, right... It's relieving, hearing that[n]from you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Eep— H-Hey! Are you trying to get[n]smacked here!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sis is going to be okay... right?[n]I'm sure she'll understand...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've been feeling pretty fit lately.[n]I suppose Shadow fighting makes[n]for good exercise.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Have you been keeping a balanced diet?[n]Be sure to take good care of your body.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Don't push yourself too hard, all right?[n]You're lucky to be alive at all, so losing[n]you here would be especially sad.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can't believe the winter wind cuts[n]all the way into Mementos... Maybe[n]I should bring an extra layer next time.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mona seems to be getting a bit sluggish...[n]Maybe I should get him something to[n]drink later.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's so different here with you all than it[n]was when it was just Mona-chan and[n]myself. I have so many friends now!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* It feels like it's been ages since[n]I made those posts on the Phan-Site...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Don't worry about me, I'm fine.[n]We have to help those people[n]relying on us.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: For some reason, I just got a craving[n]for some of Boss's coffee.
Stop by anytime.
I'll make you some.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you! I'll be sure to visit soon then.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You... You will? Oh, thank you![n]I'm delighted to hear it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Say, Joker, the soil has been especially[n]fertile lately—do you think you could[n]sneak up to the roof sometime?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I wonder what's waiting for us beyond[n]here... I wonder if Mona-chan will be[n]all right, too...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are back in action![n]I'm so happy we're all together again.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I still can't forgive Crow-kun for[n]what he did... But, I really am glad[n]that he survived.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wh-Whoa... S-So many people...[n]I-I'm okay, I've got this...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: No matter the layout of this maze,[n]I can see right through it! ...I think![n]...Sometimes!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Say, if we dyed Mona's fur, would that[n]change his car-mode's paint job too?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Watching the trains blow through here[n]reminds me of when we went to Akiba[n]together... Oh, I'm fine now, though!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Nobody knows what'll happen from[n]here on out—I gotta make sure I do[n]my job.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If you can't ever go back to school,[n]I'll just hafta take you under my wing,[n]Joker!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hmm, I think we'll be able to go a bit[n]further, but... what is this I'm picking up?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This floor is clearly different from[n]anything we've seen before. Stay[n]on your toes!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Man, we've got one OP team here![n]I feel like we could do anything!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So you're attempting to help people[n]even now? Now that's something.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're very strong, Joker. I've glimpsed[n]your true power yet again.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Whoever would have guessed I would[n]team up with YOU again. Just don't[n]hold me back, got it?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...I'll pass on the friendly chatter.[n]Once our business is concluded,[n]we're done.

entries.speaker: [sumi 10 0]
entries.en: Thank you so much for bringing me[n]along, Joker-senpai—I promise I won't[n]be a burden!

entries.speaker: [sumi 10 0]
entries.en: I'm done pretending... Please, give me[n]strength, Kasumi!
